Load Packages

library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(png)

library(here)

A Single Point

single_point <- tibble(x = 0, y = 0)

single_point |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y
    ))+
  geom_point() +
  theme_void()

Random Lines

number_of_lines <- 300

random_lines <- tibble(
  # Get 50 numbers between 1 and 50 without replacement
  x = sample(1:number_of_lines, number_of_lines),
  y = 1:number_of_lines
  )

random_lines |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    xend = median(x),
    yend = median(y)
  )) +
  geom_segment() +
  theme_void()

Square?

square <- tibble(
  x = c(0, number_of_lines, number_of_lines, 0),
  y = c(0, 0, number_of_lines, number_of_lines)
  )

square |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y
    )) +
  geom_polygon(
    fill = NA,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void()

Combine square + random lines

square |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y
    )) +
  geom_polygon(
    fill = NA,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = random_lines,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      xend = number_of_lines/2,
      yend = number_of_lines/2
    )
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void()

Without the xend argument

square |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y
    )) +
  geom_polygon(
    fill = NA,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = random_lines,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      xend = , #lol
      yend = 25
    )
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void()

Add random colour

random_lines_cartesian <- random_lines |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    xend = number_of_lines/2,
    yend = number_of_lines/2
    )) +
  geom_segment(
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = sample(
      brewer.pal(5,"Purples"), nrow(random_lines), replace = TRUE
      )
    ) +
  theme_void()

random_lines_cartesian
random_lines_cartesian +
  coord_radial()

Density Plots

planet <- tibble(crossing(
  x = sample(1:1000, 100, replace = TRUE),
  y = sample(1:2000, 100, replace = TRUE)
))

planet
# A tibble: 9,408 × 2
       x     y
   <int> <int>
 1    10     3
 2    10    42
 3    10    49
 4    10    89
 5    10    90
 6    10    99
 7    10   112
 8    10   135
 9    10   153
10    10   160
# ℹ 9,398 more rows
planet |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y
    )) +
  geom_point()
#planet_colours <- c("#194157","#008dd7","#085b88","#26925e","#095c88")
planet_colours <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, "YlGnBu")

planet_flat <- planet |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y
    )) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = sample(planet_colours, 200, replace = TRUE)
    ) +
  geom_density2d_filled(
    color = "brown4",
    linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

planet_flat
planet_polar <- planet_flat +
  coord_polar()

planet_polar

Create some stars

stars <- tibble(crossing(
  x = seq(1,2000,100),
  y = seq(1,2000,100)
  ))
stars_plot <- stars |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y
    )) +
  geom_jitter(
    size = sample(
      c(.02,.04,.06,.8),
      nrow(stars),
      replace = TRUE
      ),
    color = "white"
    ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#000000",
      color = "#ffffff",
      linewidth = 6
      )
    )

stars_plot

Save Planet into directory

ggsave(
  here("planet.png"),
  planet_polar,
  bg = "transparent", 
  device = "png"
  )
Saving 7 x 5 in image

Read planet.png into R

planet_png <- readPNG(here("planet.png"))

Combine stars and planet

stars_plot |> 
  ggdraw() +
  draw_image(planet_png)
